cand.title: Semana Internacional de la Construcción (SICON)
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified organizer-side relationship routes, not proven accommodation buyers: Elena Hurtado, director general of Expo Guadalajara, and Ana Sánchez Terán, director of International Expansion at IFEMA Madrid. Both are identified in SICON’s April 2026 activity coverage. Ask them or their teams to route the hotel to the actual accommodation/hosted-buyer programme owner. Neither source establishes hotel-contract signature authority.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed within the requested horizon: second edition, 20–22 April 2027, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. These are activity dates in the venue calendar and the organizer’s closing release, not publication dates. The organizer release is dated 17 April 2026; the independent reconfirmation is dated 29 June 2026. No verified 2028 edition dates were located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is a strong city-hotel accommodation and ancillary-meeting fit, not a resort-led destination proposal. Marriott places it minutes from Expo Guadalajara and Plaza del Sol and publishes meeting/catering services. Historical scale—more than 5,500 professional visitors and more than 120 exhibiting brands in 2026—and a reinforced 2027 hosted-buyer programme justify asking about visiting exhibitors, delegates and organizer teams. These are prospect segments, not confirmed room demand. The hotel’s overview and events page report different meeting-space totals; do not use an unverified capacity promise in the proposal.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara’s calendar assigns the 2027 exhibition to Salón Jalisco A y B, 10:00–18:00. This is a published venue assignment, not inspection of a signed contract. Expo Guadalajara is a non-hotel venue; its commitment does not establish whether accommodation sourcing is open or closed.
findings.historicalRotation: 2026 was the first edition, held 14–16 April at Expo Guadalajara. The confirmed second edition returns there on 20–22 April 2027. Evidence establishes two consecutive editions in the same destination, not a rotating-destination series or a guaranteed indefinite annual cycle. No earlier Mexican edition or confirmed 2028 rotation was found.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, not verified open or closed. The official lodging page publishes a special agreement with Barceló Guadalajara and gives its direct hotel contact. It also lists RIU Guadalajara, Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara, Hotel Westin Guadalajara, Real Inn, Barceló and Hampton Inn Expo as accommodation options. The page is branded SICON México 2027 but does not state the Barceló agreement’s validity dates, rates, allocation, exclusivity or booking cutoff. The generic Sheraton listing does not prove a contract with this exact property. Organizer contact form, +52 33 1865 6427 and igomez@expoguadalajara.mx are published routing channels; the email holder’s full name and purchasing authority are unverified. No appointed housing agency/PCO, hotel RFP, contracted room block or peak-room figure was located.
findings.organizationStructure: This is a jointly organized B2B trade exhibition by IFEMA MADRID and Expo Guadalajara, not evidenced as an association-owned congress. Expo Guadalajara has dual roles as co-organizer and venue. CMIC and CANADEVI are named institutional supporters; the inauguration release additionally describes collaboration with CMIC Jalisco. These roles do not make the chambers accommodation buyers. No external agency, PCO or DMC appointment was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Barceló Guadalajara has the only explicitly identified special lodging agreement in the reviewed official accommodation material. Multiple other hotels are promoted. This is genuine competition but not evidence of exclusivity, sold-out blocks, overflow, rates, pickup or committed inventory. Do not describe overflow as existing demand or the main exhibition as available to move into a hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the published SICON Mexico route (+52 33 1865 6427; igomez@expoguadalajara.mx or the official contact form). Request the accommodation/hosted-buyer programme lead, referencing Elena Hurtado and Ana Sánchez Terán as relevant co-organizer routes, not presumed buyers. First confirm whether the generic Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara listing refers to this property and whether an existing arrangement already applies. Ask whether the Barceló agreement covers 2027, is exclusive, and permits another hotel. If permitted, propose a needs-led guestroom and small-meeting offer around 20–22 April 2027; obtain arrival/departure patterns and required quantities before quoting. If 2027 is closed, ask for the next hotel-partner review date rather than assuming 2028 dates or an RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the next edition, April 2027, the exhibition venue is already assigned. Accommodation access remains unconfirmed rather than closed: the official website provides lodging options and a special Barceló agreement. Approach for additional accommodation participation, hosted-buyer/exhibitor introductions and ancillary functions only as exploratory paths, subject to incumbent terms. The completed 2026 edition is historical evidence, not current inventory.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue a complementary 2027 accommodation position first, then a relationship for the next lodging-partner review. Two consecutive Guadalajara editions support continuity but not an open 2028 bid or destination rotation. A later-edition hotel agreement might be contestable; timing, scope and incumbent renewal rights remain unknown. No confirmed post-2027 edition is asserted.
